newsitem.title: UK: Novo up after results, upbeat statement.
newsitem.headline: Novo up after results, upbeat statement.

text.p: Shares in Novo Group Plc rose 15 percent on Tuesday after the media services group posted a sharp rise in yearly profits coupled with an upbeat trading statement.
The shares were up 5p to 37-1/2 by 0930 GMT in volume of 25,000.
The company, which specialises in film storage, archiving, duplication and distribution and operates in all the major film centres around the world, said current trading was ahead of forecasts.

"While some pricing pressure has been experienced in both the storage and distribution businesses, operating efficiencies are improving margins and allowing for continued profit growth," it said in a statement.
"Current trading continues to be encouraging and is ahead of expectations."

Pre-tax profit rose 13 percent to 3.3 million stg on turnover which was little changed at 17.4 million stg. Earnings per share increased 18 percent to 4.51p and the dividend was increased 10 percent to 1.1p per share.
Novo added that it was exploring specific acquisition opportunities to extend the range and depth of its services but gave no further details.
